analysis: Exploratory, selected after the primary coverage study
reference_rule: Odd ranks (1-based) after sorting the 100 filenames by numeric suffix
reference_estimator: The estimated assignment probability is (row treatment count + 0.5) / 51. It requires treatment assignments from 50 sibling simulations.
mcse_scope: Paired SD across 50 evaluation files divided by sqrt(50), conditional on the observed set of reference assignments and fixed X.
